description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateStatusAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. The class provides an API endpoint for listing candidate statuses with internationalization support, implementing only the 'getAll' method for retrieving all candidate statuses as a list of id-label pairs.

classes.name: CandidateStatusAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving candidate statuses with internationalization support. Implements the 'getAll' method to list all statuses as id-label pairs.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all candidate statuses, returns them as an array of id and label, with labels translated using the I18N helper.
